ZHIJIANG_KEYWORD_YANG.title: Yang
ZHIJIANG_KEYWORD_YANG.description: Yang card. Bella is in the Bai La state when Yang cards outnumber Yin cards. The Yin-Yang difference is the gap between the number of Yang and Yin cards.
ZHIJIANG_KEYWORD_YIN.title: Yin
ZHIJIANG_KEYWORD_YIN.description: Yin card. Bella is in the Hei La state when Yin cards outnumber Yang cards. The Yin-Yang difference is the gap between the number of Yang and Yin cards.
